```{r generate_summary_csv}
# Build the proportions comparison summary from the raw SQANTI files and
# write it to data/sqanti_proportions_comparison.csv
files_map <- data.frame(
  path = c(
    "data/sqanti_new/kinnex_norm_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/cDNA_norm_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/drna_norm_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/neuron_pb_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/neuron_ont_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/masseq_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/isoseq_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/ont_sqanti_summary_global.csv"
  ),
  Dataset = c("LongBench", "LongBench", "LongBench", "iNeuron", "iNeuron", "Mouse", "Mouse", "Mouse"),
  Platform = c("PacBio", "ONT", "ONT", "PacBio", "ONT", "PacBio", "PacBio", "ONT"),
  LibType = c("Kinnex", "ONT cDNA", "ONT dRNA", "Kinnex", "ONT cDNA", "Kinnex", "Iso-Seq", "ONT cDNA"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Load, clean, and filter
all_data <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(files_map)) {
  if (file.exists(files_map$path[i])) {
    df <- read_csv(files_map$path[i], show_col_types = FALSE)
    df <- df %>% filter(Tool != "isoseq")
    df$Biotype <- gsub("\n", " ", df$Biotype)
    df$Biotype[df$Biotype == "Genic Genomic"] <- "Genic\nGenomic"
    df$Biotype[df$Biotype == "Genic Intron"] <- "Genic\nIntron"
    df$Dataset <- files_map$Dataset[i]
    df$Platform <- files_map$Platform[i]
    df$LibType <- files_map$LibType[i]
    all_data[[i]] <- df
  } else {
    warning(paste("File missing:", files_map$path[i]))
  }
}

full_df <- bind_rows(all_data)

# Classify Known (FSM) vs Novel
summary_df <- full_df %>%
  mutate(
    IsoformClass = factor(if_else(Biotype == "FSM", "Known (FSM)", "Novel"), levels = c("Novel", "Known (FSM)")),
    FilteredLabel = factor(if_else(Filtered, "After\nFiltering", "Before\nFiltering"), levels = c("Before\nFiltering", "After\nFiltering"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dataset, LibType, Tool, FilteredLabel, IsoformClass) %>%
  summarize(Count = sum(n_trans), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Dataset, LibType, Tool, FilteredLabel) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Percentage = if_else(Total > 0, Count / Total * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Write the summary table to a CSV file
write.csv(summary_df, "data/sqanti_proportions_comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r load_data}
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    Tool = case_when(
      Tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      Tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      Tool == "bambu"    ~ "Bambu",
      TRUE               ~ as.character(Tool)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Tool %in% c("FLAIR", "Bambu", "IsoQuant"))

# Pivot wide to calculate pct before and after filtering
pct_wide <- summary_df %>%
  select(Dataset, LibType, Tool, FilteredLabel, IsoformClass, Count) %>%
  group_by(Dataset, LibType, Tool, FilteredLabel) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Count)) %>%
  filter(IsoformClass == "Known (FSM)") %>%
  mutate(PctKnown = Count / Total * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Dataset, LibType, Tool, FilteredLabel, PctKnown) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = FilteredLabel, values_from = PctKnown, values_fill = 0)

colnames(pct_wide)[colnames(pct_wide) == "Before\nFiltering"] <- "Before"
colnames(pct_wide)[colnames(pct_wide) == "After\nFiltering"] <- "After"

pct_wide <- pct_wide %>%
  mutate(Delta = After - Before)

# Calculate significance p-value using independent contingency tables
sig_data <- summary_df %>%
  group_by(Dataset, LibType, Tool) %>%
  do({
    sub_df <- .
    wide <- sub_df %>%
      select(FilteredLabel, IsoformClass, Count) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = FilteredLabel, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0)

    colnames(wide)[colnames(wide) == "Before\nFiltering"] <- "Before"
    colnames(wide)[colnames(wide) == "After\nFiltering"] <- "After"

    if (!"Before" %in% colnames(wide)) wide[["Before"]] <- 0
    if (!"After" %in% colnames(wide)) wide[["After"]] <- 0

    wide <- wide %>%
      mutate(
        Passed = After,
        Failed = Before - After
      )

    mat <- as.matrix(wide %>% select(Passed, Failed))

    p_val <- NA
    if (sum(mat) > 0) {
      test_res <- tryCatch(chisq.test(mat), error = function(e) NA)
      if (is.list(test_res)) p_val <- test_res$p.value
    }

    data.frame(p_value = p_val)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Apply Bonferroni correction for multiple hypothesis testing (24 tests)
sig_data <- sig_data %>%
  mutate(
    p_value_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
    log_p = if_else(is.na(p_value_adj), 0, -log10(p_value_adj)),
    log_p = if_else(is.infinite(log_p) | log_p > 300, 300, log_p),
    label = case_when(
      p_value_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    )
  )

plot_data <- inner_join(pct_wide, sig_data, by = c("Dataset", "LibType", "Tool"))

# Factors
plot_data$Dataset <- factor(plot_data$Dataset, levels = c("Mouse", "iNeuron", "LongBench"))
plot_data$LibType <- factor(plot_data$LibType, levels = c("Iso-Seq", "Kinnex", "ONT cDNA", "ONT dRNA"))
plot_data$Tool <- factor(plot_data$Tool, levels = c("FLAIR", "Bambu", "IsoQuant"))
```

```{r colors_and_theme}
# Color maps matching unified technology colors and white background for column facets (datasets)
color_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#4A5899",  # Sandy gold
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Soft Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93",  # PacBio pink
  "Mouse"    = "#FFFFFF",  # Pure White
  "iNeuron"   = "#FFFFFF",
  "LongBench"= "#FFFFFF"
)

# Text colors for facet labels (white for colored technology row strips, black for white dataset column strips)
lab_text_palette <- data.frame(
  name = c("ONT dRNA", "ONT cDNA", "Iso-Seq", "Kinnex", "Mouse", "iNeuron", "LongBench"),
  lab_color = c("#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#000000", "#000000", "#000000"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Theme Nature Clean
theme_nature_clean <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.spacing = unit(5, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, r = 2, l = 2),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(4, "pt")
    )
}
```

```{r plot}
# Main plot
log_p_max <- max(plot_data$log_p, na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.na(log_p_max) || log_p_max < 1.302) {
  log_p_max <- 1.302
}
break_val <- -log10(0.05)

p_delta <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Delta, y = Tool)) +
  # Draw vertical grey dashed line at Delta = 0 behind the bars
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = log_p), stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#f7fcb9", "#addd8e", "#d8daeb", "#54278f"),
    values = c(0, break_val, break_val + 1e-5, log_p_max) / log_p_max,
    name = expression(-log[10]*"(adj p-value)"),
    limits = c(0, log_p_max)
  ) +
  # Grid faceting: LibType as rows, Dataset as columns, with colorized technology strips and custom text colors
  facet_grid_color(LibType ~ Dataset, colors = color_palette, lab_colors = lab_text_palette) +
  # Add small buffer to x-axis limits to prevent text clipping
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = "Delta in % of Known Transcripts (After - Before)",
    y = "Tool",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_nature_clean()
```

```{r export}
# Export function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 130, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4

  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

save_pub_r(p_delta, "plots/Supplementary_Figure_5", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 130)
message("Delta comparison plot generated successfully.")
```
